Smoke test: load linkerscript and parse a simple snippet

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"language\":\"linkerscript\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "SECTIONS { .text : { *(.text) } }", config: configObj)
print(result)
```
